name: scenes
title: Scenes and ids
description: Shapes keyed by id. Shuffle moves them, Add fades one in, Remove fades one out. Colour is a CSS transition.

name: binary-search
title: Binary search
description: Generator frames, a code trace, and pointers that slide.

name: why-fast
title: Halving
description: Why binary search takes log₂ n steps.

name: bubble-sort
title: Keys decide what moves
description: With keys, a swap slides two tiles past each other. Without, the numbers change in place.

name: hash-map
title: Hash map
description: Two Sum with a map of values seen. Rows are keyed by the map key, so each entry drops in as its own row.

name: linked-list
title: Reversing a linked list
description: Each arrow is keyed by the node it leaves, so flipping a pointer swings it round.

name: bst
title: Binary search tree
description: Insert and search; new nodes grow out of their parent.

name: tidy-tree
title: Tidy trees
description: Reingold–Tilford for n-ary trees: subtrees pushed together until their outlines almost touch.

name: graph
title: BFS and DFS
description: Drag the nodes; click one to start from it.

name: layered
title: Layered layout and node kinds
description: A pipeline with no coordinates: layers follow the edges, long edges bend around boxes. Click a task to see its blast radius, coloured by node kind.

name: graph-coloring
title: Graph colouring
description: Click to cycle colours; clashing edges turn red.

name: lcs
title: Dynamic programming table
description: Longest common subsequence, with dependency arrows and a traceback.

name: tangent
title: Tangent lines
description: Drag along the curve. Switching functions morphs the curve.

name: riemann
title: Riemann sums
description: Drag a and b, change n and the rule.

name: vectors
title: Vectors
description: Sum, difference and projection, with draggable tips.

name: dice
title: Sample space
description: Two dice. Click a cell or a bar to choose the event.

name: venn
title: Venn diagram
description: Regions built from arcs, so they can be shaded and measured. Drag the circles.

name: bayes
title: Probability tree
description: Multiply along the branches; Bayes compares the two + leaves.

name: galton
title: Galton board
description: Keyed balls falling one row per tick into binomial bins.

name: large-numbers
title: Law of large numbers
description: Frequencies settle on 1/6 and the running mean on 3.5.

name: monty-hall
title: Monty Hall
description: Play, then simulate a few hundred games.

name: pythagoras
title: Square in a square
description: Drag the point on the top edge.

name: triangle
title: Triangle centres
description: Drag the vertices. The angle arc becomes a square at exactly 90°.

name: inscribed
title: Inscribed angle
description: Drag P around the circle; the angle stays half the arc.

name: scheduling
title: CPU scheduling
description: simulate (@dsviz/os) plus a Gantt chart keyed by process and segment.

name: python-memory
title: Names and objects
description: Frames, heap objects and reference arrows.

name: pointers
title: Pointer arithmetic
description: The same bytes as char, int or double.

name: uml-arrows
title: UML relationships
description: The six arrows, each beside the code that creates it.

name: class-diagram
title: Class diagram
description: Drag the classes; click one to see only its relationships.

name: sequence
title: Sequence diagram
description: A login, step by step. Activation bars follow the call stack.

name: checkout
title: Alternatives and notes
description: An alt fragment with an [else] branch, per-message tones for the failure path, a note in its own row, and activation bars you can turn off.

name: state-machine
title: State machine
description: An order lifecycle. Only legal events are enabled.

name: request-flow
title: A request through a web stack
description: Hop by hop with latency: cache hit versus miss.

name: load-balancer
title: Load balancing
description: Round robin, least connections and random, with a slow server. Click a server to take it down.

name: consistent-hashing
title: Consistent hashing
description: Add or remove a server and count the keys that move, ring versus hash % N.

name: trust-zones
title: Trust boundaries
description: Zones around machines and a sandbox. Step a job across and see which files may cross.

name: git-graph
title: Merge versus rebase
description: graph from @dsviz/git: lanes by first parent, curved edges, branch pills. Commits are keyed by hash, so the switch animates.

name: polling
title: Polling in a loop
description: A sequence diagram with a loop fragment that grows as the polls come back.

name: deployment
title: Deployment diagram
description: Machines (3D nodes) with a nested runtime and the files it hosts, joined by «protocol» lines. Add a second server and a load balancer: the nodes slide over. Click one to read what it runs.

name: object-diagram
title: Class view and object view
description: The same ids drawn as classes or as live objects (name : Class, slots). Switch and the boxes morph.

name: package-diagram
title: Package diagram
description: Folders nested to any depth, relations routed in lanes between the rows. Click a package to see what it imports; flatten to see the leaves as a plain dependency graph.

name: communication
title: Communication diagram
description: The login beside its sequence diagram, from one message list and one player: a ring of participants, one link per pair, and each message a small arrow riding its link with a Dewey number (1, 1.1, 1.1.1).

name: er
title: Entity–relationship
description: A shop schema in crow's-foot notation. Click an entity to read its relationships as sentences; the switch hides the attributes.

name: use-case
title: Use case diagram
description: A web shop: actors, ovals, «include» and «extend», cases ordered by who uses them. Click an actor to see their reach; toggle the system boundary.

name: activity
title: Activity diagram
description: An order across three swimlanes: a decision with guards, a fork and join round two parallel actions, a flow final. Step through, or switch the stock off to take the other branch.

name: component
title: Component diagram
description: A shop: lollipops (provides) and sockets (requires) plug together into assemblies; a port on the backend delegates to the part inside. Click a component to read its interfaces; hide the inside to see it as a black box.
